title: New Update Available
message: Admin test build. Version 1.0.14 fixes image sending, chest ad claim timing, and signup reward popup eligibility.
fixes: Restored comment, direct chat, and room image uploads
Kept server-side moderation mandatory for public feed posts
Fixed rewarded chest waiting for the ad reward callback before claiming
Fixed eligible new accounts being blocked from opening the signup reward popup
Kept existing accounts excluded from signup rewards unless explicitly eligible
